The '''Bamboo Pole''' is a [[Tools|tool]] used to catch [[fish]]. One is obtained from [[Willy]] in the cutscene following the completion of the [[Quests#To The Beach|To The Beach]] quest. Afterwards, it can be purchased from his [[Fish Shop]] for {{Price|500}}. It cannot have [[bait]] or [[tackle]] attached to it.

The Bamboo Pole can be given a random [[Forge#Tool enchantments|enchantment]] at the Forge.
